stories.title: Refactor BASIC Report to Match Sample Design
stories.description: As a product owner, I want the BASIC tier report to match the BASIC_TIER_SAMPLE_REPORT.md design, so that it provides educational value without AI fixes.
acceptanceCriteria: BASIC report does NOT include AI-generated fix code snippets
BASIC report includes Educational Resources section with learning paths
BASIC report includes Gamification section (XP, skills, achievements)
BASIC report includes IDE Integration section (SARIF, GitLab, LSP exports)
BASIC report includes 'Pattern Contribution' opt-in section
Issue sections show 'Recommendation' text guidance only (no code fixes)
Clear differentiation message showing BASIC vs PRO capabilities
stories.technicalNotes: Key files: v9-report-formatter.ts, v9-grouped-report-formatter.ts. Reference: BASIC_TIER_SAMPLE_REPORT.md

changesApplied: Added tier-gating for AI-generated code display in generateGroupSection()
BASIC tier now shows 'Upgrade to PRO' prompts instead of code
PRO tier continues to show full AI-generated fix code

stories.title: Refactor PRO Report to Show Fix Results
stories.description: As a product owner, I want the PRO tier report to match the PRO_TIER_SAMPLE_REPORT.md design, showing actual fix results with before/after comparisons.
acceptanceCriteria: PRO report shows 'Fix Summary' with count of fixed vs pending issues
PRO report shows before/after code comparisons for each fix
PRO report includes confidence scores per fix (e.g., 95%)
PRO report includes verification status (FIXED, PENDING, FAILED)
PRO report shows 'Pending Issues' section for manual review items
PRO report includes 'Apply Fixes' CLI commands section
Score shows before/after improvement (e.g., 72 → 94/100)
Business Impact shows time saved metrics
stories.technicalNotes: Key files: v9-full-report-formatter.ts, v9-report-formatter-enhanced.ts. Reference: PRO_TIER_SAMPLE_REPORT.md

changesApplied: Added generatePROFixSummary() method for PRO tier
Shows fix count by status (Auto-Fixed, Pending Review, Already Resolved)
Groups fixed issues by category with confidence scores
Adds Pending Issues section with manual review reasons
Adds Apply Fixes CLI section with commands
Adds Business Impact with time saved metrics
